champion.builds: THE BEST GAREN BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Garen Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Axiom Arcanist and Celerity in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Stridebreaker as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Phantom Dancer. For your last 3 items, you should build Infinity Edge, Spear of Shojin and finish with Sterak's Gage. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 36.3% winrate over 168 matches played. Optional Your second option for Garen Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Phase Rush as your keystone, Axiom Arcanist, Celerity and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, and Overgrowth with Second Wind in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Stridebreaker, which you should build first, followed by Berserker's Greaves as your second item and Phantom Dancer as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Infinity Edge, Mortal Reminder and Sterak's Gage. The skill order for this build is E - Q - W. In the current patch, this build has a 30.8% win rate over 91 matches. Situational Garen Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Garen build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Garen runes page.
